about: Every build the founder rejected for a reason a gate should have caught. Each must make the named gates HALT; if a gate passes one, the gate is broken (self-test exits 2). Add a row each time the founder rejects a build.

rejections.verdict: this landscape is blurry and glitchy and layers are off and seams are noticeable
rejections.why_gates_missed_it: Studio Eyes and Studio Fingers read the DOM only; the world is a canvas.

fixtures_rule: Fixtures are full builds and this repo is public: they live in Drive Claude_files (drive_id) and are mounted locally at the fixture path, never committed. Missing fixture = self-test BLIND (exit 3), reported by belt tick 15, never a pass.

generated_canaries.why: camera dead zone loosened to 49%: player drifts to the screen edge (F-CENTER)
